description:
Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface and create a new Person Attribute Type with the following details:

1. Name: 'Preferred Language'
2. Format: 'java.lang.String'
3. Description: 'Patient\'s preferred language for translation and interpreter services'
4. Searchable: Checked/Enabled

Starting from the Bahmni Home screen, you will need to navigate to the OpenMRS Admin backend (often found via the app menu or by modifying the URL to /openmrs/admin). Login with username 'superman' and password 'Admin123' if prompted.
